periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight anterior inclination relative to the head position.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio characterized by an oval, elongated vertical profile.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the lower margin, extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Posterior edge exhibits a wide, shallow U-shaped curvature.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Large band thickness, covering approximately 40-50% of the visible dorsal-ventral trunk height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation between pinnae, with an inter-ear gap roughly equal to the transverse width of one ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex curvature at the superior boundaries of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct chromatic transition to yellowish-brown fur on the lower posterior and ventral regions compared to the white cranial fur.
